resources.string: Forced idle and sensor restriction lift while a call is ringing or active, audio plays, car mode or Android Auto is on, the hotspot is on, the phone charges, or a keep-awake app was in front at screen off. Doze timings stay. Hold-offs cannot be turned off: they keep calls, alarms, navigation and music working.
None. Add an app that must keep working with the screen off, such as a navigation app.
When another app changes the Doze timings, put the profile\'s values back and log who changed them. Off: only log it.
Lets Tasker and similar apps apply profiles, pause the plan and read the status, through broadcasts guarded by a permission.
Installed, not allowed yet. Allow grants it the permission.
Older sessions and their records are deleted. Raw dumps are kept for 7 days either way.
Every session, night and action the app keeps, for a bug report or your own records.
English or Turkish, set in the phone\'s settings for this app.
Only the accent changes; verdict and timeline colours stay fixed so they read the same every night.

Off by default. Google services can push Doze values that overwrite a profile; re-apply on drift already puts them back. This stops every server-pushed setting on the phone, not only Doze\'s, until you turn it off.
Google\'s server-pushed settings stop for every part of the system, not only Doze, until you turn this off here. Fixes Google ships that way will not arrive meanwhile.
Restore stock puts back the phone\'s own Doze timings, sensor state and allowlist. Reset also deletes everything the app keeps.
The phone\'s own Doze timings, sensor state and allowlist come back. Records stay.
Restores stock, then deletes every record, custom profile and setting the app keeps. This cannot be undone.
